shared_elements: human figure in low relief, shown in profile
long robe with patterned/pleated drapery and fringed hem
hand grasping a rod- or staff-like object
incised linear detailing to indicate folds and fringes
figures arranged in a horizontal band with a subsidiary decorated/inscribed band below
justification: Both show shallow-relief human figures in profile wearing long robes whose folds and fringed hems are rendered with fine incised lines, with hands gripping slender staff-like implements, and in both the figural band is bordered below by a separate decorated band (inscription in A, a row of rosettes in B). The clearest difference in content is that A presents a legible pair of confronted bearded figures with elaborately curled hair and beards, while B preserves only the lower garment and disconnected hands plus a rosette border, so no heads, faces or facing relationship can be matched.
